answer: Because the timing is recorded against the comet challenge, the lotus audit can replay the nadir history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 122 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4025 identities would post 2634 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
